findings: Class-share ranges overlap between faster/slower predictions; medians do not establish an edge-level correction.
All six new misses and two persistent misses have detailed Census source geometry. High source-to-ORS proximity does not complete the base/attachment geometry.
The fixed-policy control shows little rerouting offset, but current joined features do not separate source-distance differences from timing assumptions.
scope: No proof that a selective generic rule is impossible. This evidence does not justify choosing one yet.
